fields.description: Program Description I. Academic Highlights This interdisciplinary dual-degree program brings together ECUST's internationally recognized strengths in Artificial Intelligence and Finance. Students learn from a distinguished faculty of AI and finance scholars, many of whom lead cutting-edge research in machine learning, financial data science, algorithmic systems, and smart decision-making. The School of Information Science and Technology and the School of Business jointly offer a research-rich environment, supported by state-of-the-art labs—including a National Engineering Laboratory for Big Data and dedicated Research Centers in Financial Data Science, Business Intelligence, and Smart Energy. Designed for the intelligent economy, the program equips students with dual literacy in AI technologies and financial markets. Graduates are prepared to tackle complex, real-world problems at their intersection — from automated trading and risk analytics to AI-driven investment platforms. Leveraging Shanghai's position as a global financial and tech hub, the program emphasizes hands-on, industry-connected learning and a global outlook. All core instruction is delivered in English, with opportunities for international exchange and collaboration. This is not merely a fusion of two disciplines, but a launchpad for future leaders in AI finance, quantitative innovation, and fintech worldwide. II. Educational Objectives This interdisciplinary program aims to cultivate versatile graduates who bridge artificial intelligence and finance. Students will develop strong quantitative and analytical foundations, enabling them to design AI-driven financial solutions, analyze complex market behaviors, and innovate at the intersection of technology and finance. Within five years of graduation, students are expected to: Solve real-world problems at the AI-finance nexus—such as algorithmic trading, risk modeling, fraud detection, and smart investment systems—using state-of-the-art machine learning and financial engineering methods. Work across disciplines collaboratively, leading or contributing to projects that require both computational thinking and financial logic, in multinational corporations, fintech firms, investment banks, or regulatory bodies. Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, bridging the gap between AI developers and financial decision-makers in a global context. Act with ethical and professional responsibility, understanding the societal, legal, and economic implications of AI in financial markets, including fairness, transparency, and data privacy. Adapt to rapid change through lifelong learning, staying current with advances in AI, blockchain, quantitative finance, and digital assets, and seizing leadership opportunities in an evolving industry landscape. Graduates are well-prepared for global careers in quantitative analysis, fintech product development, AI-driven trading, financial data science, and technology management, or for pursuing advanced degrees in finance, AI, or related fields. III.Core Courses Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning Algorithm, Discrete Mathematics, Algorithm and Data Structures, Database Principles, Software Engineering, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Micro-Economics, Macroeconomics, Financial Market, International Finance, Corporate Finance. IV.Graduation Criterion and Degree 1. Graduation Credit Required: 135. General Courses 17 credits, Disciplinary Courses 23 credits, Specialty Courses 77 credits, Practical Activities and Training Courses 16 credits, Innovation and Entrepreneurship Course 2 credits. 2. Duration: 3 years. 3. Degree Conferred: Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Economics. V. Course Arrangement by Semester Official Curriculum Statement The curriculum outlined herein is the official version revised and published by ECUST in May 2026. ECUST reserves the right to revise programme content annually to maintain academic relevance and rigour. For the most current information, please refer to the latest version available on our official website.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal Record Certificate If applicant is unable to get one at home country, please sign Non-criminal Record Affirmation. International students studying in China can submit a certificate of no bad performance issued by school. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Letters of recommendation * 3. Statement of Financial Support You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Study Plan(minimum of 800 words with introduction of yourself and your family, reasons for choosing ECUST and the major) 5. Foreigner Physical Examination Form with validity of less than 6 months when submission(applicants for scholarship must submit). You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Additional documents when necessary Applicants in design program should provide at least 1 art work. * 7. Handwriting Signature * 8. Self-introduction (recorded in video) No longer than 3 minutes. * 9. Copy of passport photo page(Valid until Sept. 1st, 2027 and beyond) * 10. A white background ID photo * 11. Transcripts of all high school courses or results of international standardization test (A-LEVEL/IB/ICGSE/AP/SAT/ACT/BC/UEC/STPM etc.) Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 12. Copy of high school diploma or equivalent certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. Prospective diploma recipients must submit an official document issued by the current school to prove the current study status and expected graduation date. If applicants are admitted, a scan copy of the graduation and degree certificate shall be sent before registration. * 13. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Note: Bachelor degree JMD programs don't require CSCA. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants holding valid foreign passports and in good health, with a high school degree or above. 2. Be aged over 16, those who are under 18 before August 31 of the application year, please visit Downloadto download and submit GUARANTEE STATEMENT. 3. Comply with the regulations （JW〔2020〕No. 12） issued by Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. 4. Applicants should meet the following language requirements English-taught Programs: minimum requirements of TOEFL 80 or IELTS 6.0 or Duolingo 105. Those who can provide English-taught proof for previous degrees or native English speakers do not need to submit the English Proficiency Certificate. 5. CSCA scores are preferred for priority admission, CSCA Test Subjects download here .
